title: Echo Protocol
game_overview: Fast-paced first-person cyber shooter with instant credit rewards, permanent armory upgrades, multi-language support (English/Español), audio controls, and endless ascending sectors.
winning_condition: Eliminate all rogue drones on each sector floor to claim the completion bonus, access the armory shop, and ascend endlessly.
losing_condition: Cybernetic armor integrity reaches zero from enemy drone laser fire.

controls.action: Move forward and backward or advance between cover points.
Strafe left and right or peek from behind cover barriers.
Toggle crouch behind bullet-damaged metallic barricades.

controls.input: Left Mouse Click / Tap Fire Button
controls.action: Fire pulse rifle with glowing laser tracer rounds.
Full on-screen mobile touch joystick, peek, fire, and reload.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Tactical Cover Flow: Meaningful peek-and-shoot mechanics where cover provides 70% damage mitigation and reloading requires smart positioning. 2. Visceral Cyberpunk Combat: Vivid neon-blue and laser-red projectile trails, sparks, dynamic muzzle flashes, and rain droplet ripples. 3. Responsive Over-The-Shoulder Perspective: Tight kinematic third-person over-the-shoulder camera with snappy aiming FOV transitions.
sections.summary: Tactical third-person cover shooter with high-voltage cyberpunk aesthetics.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player spawns behind urban cover barriers in District 2. Rogue combat drones and cyber-enforcers patrol and flank. The player peeks or aims over cover to line up precision shots on enemy weakpoints (power cores). Defeating enemies awards credits and drops shield recharges. Surviving 3 escalating combat waves completes the sector mission.
sections.summary: Take cover, aim, eliminate enemy drone waves, collect ammo and power cells, advance.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Dynamic Cover System: When crouching near metallic barricades, damage taken is heavily reduced and weapon recoil decreases. 2. Plasma Assault Rifle: High-precision energy weapon featuring modular holographic sights, laser guide beam, and dynamic heat/ammo management. 3. Drone Swarm AI: Aerial recon drones hover and beam tracking lasers, while heavy assault synths advance with suppressive fire. 4. Overdrive Cyber-Dash: Quick tactical dash to transition between cover points when under heavy fire.
sections.summary: Cover system, pulse assault rifle ballistics, drone AI tactics, and kinetic cyber-dash.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: 3D Coordinate System: Three.js right-handed coordinate convention (+Y Up, +X Right, -Z Forward into the neon alleyway). Camera Perspective: Over-the-shoulder offset camera (+1.2 X, +1.8 Y, +3.5 Z relative to player) that dynamically tightens to +0.8 X, +1.6 Y, +2.2 Z when aiming (Right-Click / Aim Button). Movement Physics: Kinematic player controller with smooth acceleration, crouch state transitions, and Rapier collision geometry preventing tunneling through neon barriers and architectural walls.
sections.summary: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera and snappy tactical locomotion.

sections.title: 3D Scene Hierarchy & Lighting Mandates
sections.content: Atmosphere: Moody underground cyber-district at night with animated neon holographic billboards (cyan, magenta, amber), wet reflective pavement with rain particle ripples, and vertical skyscraper scaffolding. Lighting: Sun/Spotlight intensity at 3.5, Ambient intensity at 1.8 with cool midnight-navy hemisphere sky and warm street-level bounce. Hazard Affordance: Hostile targeting lasers and incoming plasma bolts glow emissive bright crimson (#ff0055), while player shielding and ammo glow electric neon-blue (#00e5ff).
sections.summary: District 2 Neon Commercial Sector with rain atmospherics and high-intensity lighting.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Player: Cybernetic operative in dark matte armor with glowing neon-blue circuit inlays, tactical visor, and bulky modular rifle. Enemies: 1. Aerial Recon Drones: Agile hovering units with searchlight beams that strafe and fire pulse bursts. 2. Heavy Enforcer Synths: Bipedal armored androids that advance with shield barriers and burst-fire cannons. 3. Apex Sentry Mech: Boss construct with rotating twin Gatling lasers and cluster micro-missiles.
sections.summary: Cybernetic soldier player vs airborne drones and armored enforcer synths.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Incoming enemy attack trajectory lines warn the player of sniper locks and incoming volleys. Cover barriers show a green/blue shield holographic indicator when the player is safely crouched and protected.
sections.summary: Clear threat indicators, cover safety highlights, and audio-visual reload alerts.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel Concept
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Laser aim sight locks with audible high-tech charging hum and subtle reticle contraction. State Change Juice: Rain streaks on screen, glowing cyber lines pulse faster when shields break, dynamic chromatic aberration on low health. Impact Juice: Muzzle flash dynamic point light bursts, metallic ricochet spark particles, satisfying bass thud on pulse rifle discharge, and robotic explosion debris on drone destruction.
sections.summary: Anticipation, state change, and impact feedback.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: State Flow: Start Screen -> Sector Briefing -> Active Tactical Gameplay -> Wave Victory / Defeat Overlays with immediate retry and score registration with the leaderboard SDK.
sections.summary: Comprehensive state machine with HUD, wave transitions, and upgrades.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Dedicated responsive virtual controls rendered conditionally when touch is detected via useIsMobile(). Includes bottom-left virtual analog joystick for movement and bottom-right quick-action buttons for Fire (large pulse button), Aim (toggle zoom), Crouch/Cover, and Reload with touch-none and pointer-events-auto properties.
sections.summary: Mobile on-screen controls for full tactical engagement on touch devices.
